class.name: Monocypher
class.brief_description: Symmetric primitives backed by Monocypher: XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD and BLAKE2b.
class.description: Keyless / symmetric cryptographic primitives: XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD (libsodium / @noble/ciphers compatible, IETF-based) and unkeyed BLAKE2b. Named "Monocypher" to describe provenance and avoid colliding with Godot core's [code]Crypto[/code] class. Failure paths return null rather than an empty array so callers can distinguish an empty plaintext (a valid [PackedByteArray]) from a genuine error.

method.name: aead_encrypt
method.description: Encrypts [param plaintext] with XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD. [param key] must be 32 bytes, [param nonce] 24 bytes (XChaCha); [param ad] may be empty. Returns [code]ciphertext || tag(16)[/code] as a [PackedByteArray], or null (with an error) if the key/nonce sizes are wrong. This addon does not manage nonces - construct them yourself (e.g. zero-padding + counter).

method.name: aead_decrypt
method.description: Decrypts [param ciphertext_with_tag] (ciphertext with the 16-byte tag appended) using XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD. Returns the plaintext as a [PackedByteArray] (possibly empty) on success, or null if authentication fails or input sizes are invalid. An empty plaintext is returned as an empty [PackedByteArray], which is distinct from the null failure value.

method.name: blake2b
method.description: Computes an unkeyed BLAKE2b digest of [param data] with output length [param out_len] bytes (1..64, default 32). Returns the digest as a [PackedByteArray], or null (with an error) if [param out_len] is out of range.
